title: Norman Rockwell art that ignited a lawsuit and a love story is now on public view
summary: So You Want to See The President! depicts a procession of visitors waiting to see Franklin Delano Roosevelt. The original 1943 Rockwell suite of illustrations goes on public view Thursday in D.C.
